password_warning_repeats: Repeats like "aaa" are easy to guess.

password_warning_common: This is a very common password.
password_warning_similar: This is similar to a commonly used password.

password_warning_recent_years: Recent years are easy to guess.
password_warning_one_word: A word by itself is easy to guess.
password_warning_dates: Dates are often easy to guess.
password_warning_names: Names and surnames by themselves are easy to guess.
password_warning_common_names: Common names and surnames are easy to guess.
password_suggestion_few_words: Use a few words, avoid common phrases.
password_suggestion_no_symbols: No need for symbols, digits or uppercase letters.

password_suggestion_uppercase: All-uppercase is almost as easy to guess as all-lowercase.
password_suggestion_reversed: Reversed words aren't much harder to guess.
password_suggestion_substitutions: Predictable substitutions like "@" instead of "a" don't help very much.
password_suggestion_keyboard: Use a longer keyboard pattern with more turns.
password_suggestion_your_years: Avoid years that are associated with you.
password_suggestion_your_dates: Avoid dates and years that are associated with you.

password_change_text: Your other sessions are logged out.

password_none: You log in through a provider only.
password_set_sent: Check your inbox: the link there sets your password.

identity_remove_text: You won't be able to log in with it any more.

error_last_identity: This is your last way to log in: link another one first.
error_full_session_required: This session was opened through your organization's provider: log in with your own account for this.
error_owns_organizations: You own organizations: transfer or delete them first.

error_totp_required: Enter a code from your authenticator app.
error_session_required: This needs a session (not an app password).

invitation_cancel_text: The link they received stops working.
library_members_text: Members of the organization given access to this library, and what they can do.

provider_delete_text: Members can't log in through it any more.
ownership_text: The owner manages the organization: its members, libraries and settings.
ownership_transfer_text: You stay a member, but these settings won't be yours any more.
organization_delete_text: Every library, file and version at once, for every member. There is no trash.

error_personal_organization: Not possible for a personal organization.

organization_new_admin_text: Owned by an existing account, which manages it from then on.
